LanguageData.NR_ClubNoCorps: The net is quiet. No corporation has made a move yet.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCorpBarsTip: Alert: how hard the corporation looks for the colony. +3 for a node, +10 the fortress, +25 the core; -2 a day. At 40 its ICE hardens and walking its ground leaves trace, at 60 ICE patrols, at 80 intrusions, mercenaries and raids.\n\nStrength: how rich it is. Strong and calm, it captures neighboring hubs; weak for long, it may collapse.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCorpIntrusion: Intrusion on the way: {0}, about {1} h to Home
LanguageData.NR_ClubCorpsHelp: Corporations live in their districts on the cyberspace map. Taking their branches, fortress and core raises their Alert; a corporation broken twice in a month or weak for long may collapse, and a new one takes its district.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCrewHireTip: A connected runner works a job for the crew for {0} hours: silver and better relations, a small risk.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCrewRaceTip: The crew posts a node; whoever takes it first wins fame. Two days.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCrewOrderTip: Pay a fixer to wreck one of the crew's jobs: they lose fame. Sometimes they find out who paid.
LanguageData.NR_ClubTopFirst: Your runner is #1 in the net.
LanguageData.NR_ClubTopNotIn: Not in the top 100 yet: #100 has {0} fame
LanguageData.NR_ClubTopHelp: Fame: a clean dive gives defense x10 (+50% on a hard branch), a fortress +100, a core +200, a won race +50, a stopped intrusion +30. It cools 1% a day. Top 10: +10% contract rewards; top 3: corporations pay more attention; #1: +20% rewards.
LanguageData.NR_RankNewsRetired: The net remembers: {0} has logged off for good.
LanguageData.NR_CorpNewsNewcomer: A new player in the net: {0}.
LanguageData.NR_CorpCollapse: {0} has collapsed. Its fortress is ruins now: deserted branches, weaker ICE, and rival crews flocking in. Its district stays empty for a while ({1} days of ruins), then a new corporation moves in.
LanguageData.NR_MercReasonCorp: {0} has put a price on the colony.
LanguageData.NR_Intrusion: An attack ({0}) set off from {1} at {2} and is walking the backbone toward Home: about {3} hours.\n\nA runner can meet it on the way and stop it with a short dive (it shows on the cyberspace map), wait for it at Home, or rely on the hub defense. Isolating the network stops it at the wall.
LanguageData.NR_IntrusionInterceptTip: A short dive into the attack's spearhead. Win and the attack never reaches Home.
LanguageData.NR_IntrusionStopped: The intrusion ({0}) was stopped on the way.
LanguageData.NR_IntrusionWall: The intrusion ({0}) hit the wall of an isolated network.
LanguageData.NR_CrewNewsSell: {CREW} dumped a batch of data on the market.
LanguageData.NR_CrewSteal: {0} is going after {1}, the node of your contract. You have a day or two to get there first.
LanguageData.NR_CrewRace: {0} posted a race: {1}. Whoever takes it first in two days wins fame.
LanguageData.NR_CrewHired: {0} works a job for {1} for {2} hours.
LanguageData.NR_CrewHireBack: {0} is back from the job with {1}: {2} silver.
LanguageData.NR_CrewHireBackHurt: {0} is back from the job with {1}: {2} silver, but the job left its mark.
LanguageData.NR_CrewGoodwillRace: {0} did not like losing the race: {1}.
